INSERT INTO dipendenti (id, nome, cognome, posizione, stipendio, data_assunzione, manager_id)
VALUES
(1, 'Mario', 'Rossi', 'CEO', 75000.00, '2020-01-15', NULL),
(2, 'Luca', 'Verdi', 'HR Manager', 60000.00, '2021-03-10', 1),
(3, 'Anna', 'Neri', 'IT Manager', 65000.00, '2019-07-22', 1),
(4, 'Paolo', 'Bianchi', 'Recruiter', 45000.00, '2022-05-01', 2),
(5, 'Sofia', 'Gallo', 'Developer', 55000.00, '2023-09-15', 3);
query: SELECT d.nome, d.cognome, d.posizione, d.stipendio, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dipendenti) AS totale_dipendenti FROM dipendenti d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dipendenti s WHERE s.manager_id = d.id) AND d.stipendio < (SELECT AVG(stipendio) FROM dipendenti) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dipendenti m WHERE m.id = d.manager_id);
